market_reason: Hot CPI pushed the 10-year yield to 5% and raised bets on a large Fed hike, but the move is widely known and being priced in, so it is not a crisis-grade shock.
market_headlines: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 slip after CPI data raises Fed rate-hike bets - Yahoo Finance
Fed officials open door to a quicker round of rate hikes as inflation worsens - Reuters
U.S. 10-Year Treasury Tops 5% on Expectations of Higher Interest Rates - WSJ
summary: Hot CPI and Fed signals of a possible half-point hike pushed the 10-year Treasury above 5% and weighed on stocks, which is a risk for the leveraged SSO position. Oil is falling on hopes the Iran war is ending, and the Paraguay bank collapse looks regional with no direct exposure for these ETFs.
